title: Pippa Middleton and James Matthews ordered to remove an unauthorised car park at £15.5 million estate
summary_full: Pippa Middleton, Princess Catherine’s sister, and her husband James Matthews have been ordered to demolish an unauthorised car park at their £15.5 million Barton Court estate. West Berkshire Council ruled against the development after local residents objected to construction without consultation, citing concerns over its impact on the rural character of Kintbury.
